title: POST /certifications/:id/transition rejects an invalid target state with 422 and surfaces allowedTransitions
steps: Call POST /certifications/:id/transition with body { targetState: 'revoked' } while the cert is in 'draft'
expectedResult: Response is 422 with body.error = 'Invalid transition: draft → revoked for certification' and body.details/allowedTransitions containing ['assigned'].

title: Share link creation is rejected for an archived certification
description: ShareLinkService.create explicitly checks cert.status === 'archived' and returns 400 'Cannot share an archived certification' before touching the entitlement/quota logic.
steps: Call POST /share-links with entityType='certification' and entityId = the archived cert's id
expectedResult: Response is 400 with error 'Cannot share an archived certification'; no ShareLink document is created.

title: runExpiryCheck acquires a distributed Redis lock and a concurrent second invocation is skipped
description: ExpiryAlertService.runExpiryCheck uses redisService.setNx('trust-vault:lock:expiry-check', '1', 5min) before processing organizations, preventing duplicate alert runs across multiple service pods.
preconditions: Redis is available and the lock key is not currently held
steps: Invoke runExpiryCheck() and, before it completes, invoke runExpiryCheck() a second time concurrently from a separate service instance/process
Observe the return values of both calls
expectedResult: The first call proceeds and returns { processed: N, alertsSent: M }. The second, concurrent call returns immediately with { processed: 0, alertsSent: 0 } because the lock is held — no duplicate alert emails/webhooks are sent for the same organizations.

title: GET /framework-mappings?certificationId= reflects a mapping immediately after POST /framework-mappings
preconditions: An activated compliance framework with at least 3 controls exists for the org
steps: POST /framework-mappings with { certificationId, frameworkId, scopeType: 'partial', includedControlIds: [ctrl1, ctrl2] }
expectedResult: The GET response includes the newly created mapping with scopeType='partial' and includedControlIds containing exactly [ctrl1, ctrl2], with no caching delay.

title: Non-transactional fallback path compensates by reverting entity status if the workflow_entries audit write fails
description: WorkflowTransitionService.transition() falls back to a non-transactional path when MongoDB transactions are unsupported (e.g. Atlas M0). If the entity status update succeeds but the subsequent workflow_entries insertOne throws, the service attempts a compensating updateOne to revert status back to currentState and logs a CRITICAL message either way.
preconditions: Test double configured to simulate an unsupported-transaction MongoDB error, and to fail the subsequent workflow_entries insertOne
steps: Force db.client.startSession()/withTransaction to throw an 'OperationNotSupportedInTransaction' error
Force the workflow_entries insertOne call to reject
Inspect the certification's status field and the logger output afterward
expectedResult: The thrown error message is 'Audit trail write failed during non-transactional transition; entity state may have been reverted' (statusCode 500). The certification's status in the DB is reverted back to its pre-transition value (compensating revert succeeded), and a CRITICAL log entry documents both the failure and the successful revert.

title: Expiring and revoked certifications fire non-blocking risk webhooks to risk-management-service
description: ExpiryAlertService.fireRiskWebhooks / fireRiskWebhooksForRevoked call riskWebhookService.fireEventAsync('/internal/trust-vault-risks/events', ...) for cert_expiring, cert_expired, and cert_revoked event types, and are designed to never throw even if the downstream call fails.
preconditions: An organization has one certification expiring in 5 days (urgent) and one certification with status='revoked'
steps: Run generateAlertsForOrganization(orgId) followed by the internal fireRiskWebhooks/fireRiskWebhooksForRevoked calls
Inspect the outbound calls captured by a mock of risk-management-service's /internal/trust-vault-risks/events endpoint
Simulate risk-management-service returning a 500 on this call and re-run
expectedResult: Two webhook events are fired: eventType 'cert_expiring' (severity 'high', matching urgent alert level) and eventType 'cert_revoked' (severity 'critical'). When the downstream call fails with 500, runExpiryCheck still completes normally and returns a valid summary — the webhook failure is swallowed, not propagated.

title: GET /workflow/my-reviews resolves the caller's identity by email fallback when the JWT subject is not a Mongo ObjectId
description: workflow.routes.ts checks /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(rawUserId) first; if the Keycloak 'sub' claim is a UUID (not a 24-hex ObjectId), it falls back to looking up client_users by request.user.email to resolve the internal userId used for the assignment aggregation.
preconditions: A user's Keycloak JWT 'sub' is a UUID string, not a 24-hex Mongo ObjectId
That user's email exists in client_users and has one certification assigned to them
steps: Call GET /workflow/my-reviews with a JWT whose userId claim is a non-ObjectId UUID
expectedResult: The endpoint successfully resolves the internal userId via the client_users email lookup and returns the one assigned certification in data — it does not return an empty array or 500.
